author: Codex

dimensions.basis: Original runtime responsibilities, component contracts, persistent-state design, and cross-application integration.
Custom trainable source, from-scratch training records, retained artifacts, and upstream-model adaptation; independent generalization remains incomplete.
Desktop/web interfaces, backend contracts, account state, developer workflows, and real-time applications.
Selected tests, retained failures, diagnostic reproduction, and bounded training checks; whole-product acceptance remains uneven.
Versioned packages and recovery evidence, with several live-service, migration, and deployment gates still open.
Architecture records, registries, evidence, and checkpoints; divergent generations increase integration and maintenance cost.

limits: Not test accuracy, percentile, credential equivalency, or qualification for a job. No proprietary method or private payload included.
